method.block: 361 sampled crank positions plus an adaptive full-stroke partition. Every interval is certified by exhausted BVH search through radius half-width+0.1mm+0.00001mm. Returned pair distances are not global-minimum claims.
method.head: Every final Float32 piston vertex at both extreme translations is inside every face halfspace of its closed conservative full-stroke polyhedron. Convexity contains all triangles at all intermediate translations. Exhausted search separates that whole envelope from its final published head mesh by more than0.100mm.
method.aggregation: Exactly twelve unique block partitions with contiguous complete travel coverage, plus twelve unique head envelope proofs; every input shares the actual published binary SHA256.

limitations: Cold runtime triangle geometry; not manufacturing tolerances or thermal distortion.
Does not certify unrelated component pairs, stress, lubrication film, combustion or contact force.
Certified threshold is greater than0.100mm. No exact global minimum gap is claimed.
